overview_description.description: Sprout is a UAE-based food and nutrition startup focused on providing healthy, plant-based meals and snacks for babies, toddlers, and children. The company develops science-backed, nutrient-rich food products designed to encourage healthy eating habits from an early age. Its offerings include ready-to-eat meals, porridges, snacks, and frozen treats made with whole-food ingredients and without preservatives, refined sugars, or artificial additives.

about_short_description.short_description: Sprout makes wholesome, ready-to-heat food for children, crafted based on nutrition science, and loved by children and busy parents.

product.name: Baby Meals (6 months+)
product.description: Ready-to-eat nutrient-diverse baby food with wholegrains, legumes, and vegetables, designed for all stages of weaning.

product.name: Toddler Meals (12 months+)
product.description: Fresh, ready meals with wholegrains, legumes, and vegetables, tailored for toddlers aged 12 months and above.

product.name: Breakfast & Snacks
product.description: Wholegrain, legume, and vegetable-based breakfast and snack items for children, available in various forms like muffins and oatmeal.

product.name: Family & Frozen Meals
product.description: Larger portion meals and frozen products designed for families and older children, including sauces and finger foods.

product.name: NutriCheck
product.description: A nutritional analysis service that evaluates a child's diet and provides tailored advice to address nutritional gaps.
